method.annotation: Both full fixed corpora at all three thresholds; Instant wraps the public call only; complete UTF-8 equality outside timing on every call, no truncation.
method.cold: Single ips(apple), 7 fresh processes after the P1.2-prescribed uncounted full warm-up; no OS cache flush or affinity. Newly copied file's first-ever execution is separately retained before warm-up, including its slower process creation. Control uses identical executable without library calls.
method.concurrent: 8 barrier-synchronized first callers in each fresh process; complete 100k output comparison at thresholds 0/1000/5062 plus public queries; 7 samples; no numeric throughput budget.
method.memory: 3 fresh paused processes per loaded/annotation threshold; GetProcessMemoryInfo absolute and delta working set/private commit and peaks. Annotation process loads full input and retains full output; Python expected buffer is loaded only AFTER memory snapshot.
method.statistics: min/median/max and nearest-rank p95, no outlier removal; 7 samples p95=max
method.warm: One uncounted complete warm-up, then 7 new processes; initialize both resources outside hot timing; full owned outputs allocated and destroyed; exact keys twice, mixed 32 words 2000 times, every registered label.

scope: Real public APIs, full annotation equality and Windows runtime budgets; excludes packaged .crate, MSRV, other platforms and publication.

startup_investigation.measurement_boundary: Compare identical executable bytes at four new paths, control/query first execution then same-file reuse. process_creation_ms measures parent time until Python Popen returns; it does not trace an individual Windows call or identify an OS component.
